welcome.title: Welcome to Clawy
welcome.description: Your AI assistant is ready to be configured

welcome.title: Welcome to Clawy
welcome.description: Clawy is a graphical interface for OpenClaw, making it easy to use AI assistants across your favorite messaging platforms.

node.description: Detect a compatible Node.js runtime before setup continues.

openclaw.description: Verify the OpenClaw package is installed and ready to launch.

gateway.description: Confirm the local Gateway Service can start and answer health checks.

status.gatewayRunningDetail: Gateway health and UI connectivity are both passing on port {{port}}.
status.gatewayStopped: Gateway service is not running yet.
status.gatewayStoppedDetail: Clawy will start the local Gateway during validation, or you can start it manually from this card.
status.gatewayTimedOutDetail: The Gateway did not become healthy before the timeout expired. Review the logs, then retry the check.
status.gatewayFailed: Gateway service failed its health check.
status.gatewayTokenMismatch: Gateway authentication no longer matches the current Clawy session.
status.gatewayTokenMismatchDetail: Restart the Gateway to apply the latest token for port {{port}}. Latest detail: {{error}}
status.gatewayPairingRequired: Gateway pairing is required before Clawy can finish validation.
status.gatewayPairingRequiredDetail: Approve the local pairing request, then run the check again. Latest detail: {{error}}
status.gatewayPortInUseDetail: Another local process is using the configured port. Stop it or change the Gateway port, then retry. Latest detail: {{error}}
status.gatewayRuntimeMissing: Gateway cannot start because a required runtime is missing.
status.gatewayRuntimeMissingDetail: Install the missing runtime dependency, then retry. Latest detail: {{error}}
status.gatewayConfigFailed: Gateway configuration needs attention before validation can pass.
status.gatewayConfigFailedDetail: Review the local configuration or logs, then retry. Latest detail: {{error}}
status.gatewayUnavailable: Gateway started but did not become reachable for the UI.
status.gatewayUnavailableDetail: Clawy could not complete a real connection to the Gateway on port {{port}}. Latest detail: {{error}}
status.gatewayAutoStartDetail: Clawy is starting the Gateway now so this step reflects a real service check.
status.gatewayAutoRestartDetail: Clawy is restarting the Gateway to apply current settings and re-run validation.
status.waitingForDependencies: Waiting for Node.js and OpenClaw to pass first.
status.nodeMissing: No compatible Node.js runtime is available.
status.openclawMissing: No compatible OpenClaw package is available.

issue.title: Environment issue detected
issue.desc: Fix the card marked with an error, then re-run the checks before continuing.

summary.pendingTitle: Runtime checks are still in progress
summary.pending: Clawy is still validating the runtime environment. Next stays disabled until all three cards are ready.
summary.readyWhenAllPass: All three cards must show Ready before you can continue to the next setup step.

provider.storedLocally: Your API key is stored locally on your machine.

channel.connectedDesc: Your channel has been configured. It will connect when the Gateway starts.

installing.subtitle: Setting up the tools needed to power your AI assistant
